name: Rik Chatterjee
biography: Currently, Rik serves as a graduate research assistant in the Department of Systems Engineering at Colorado State University, working under Dr. Jeremy Daily. His role involves research on security of protocol implementations and cybersecurity in the domain of commercial heavy and medium duty vehicles. Driven by a passion for securing embedded systems, Rik's work emphasizes the importance of robust security measures in protecting critical transportation infrastructure against emerging cyber threats.
